Screen Recordings album organization vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Control Center screen recording on device covers storefront language. ReplayKit capture, the red status pill, and Connect actually separate in-app Screen Recordings behavior from product-page copy:

  • Photos → Albums → Screen Recordings — the system album where Control Center screen capture videos land on the buyer's device. Controls on-device organization — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • Control Center screen capture — recordings started from Control Center with the screen-recording toggle and the red status pill while capture runs. Product-page copy should describe that workflow; building capture UI is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Red recording status pill — the in-status-bar indicator buyers see while a screen recording is active. Listing copy may reference the pill on gallery frames; implementing status-bar UI is in-app engineering.
  • Start and stop screen recording — Control Center start and stop actions before clips save to the Screen Recordings album. zh-Hans overlays should name those actions when your English frames show recording controls — not English-only "Start recording" pasted through machine translation.
  • Find screen recordings & distinguish from Screenshots — buyers open the Screen Recordings album to locate capture videos instead of the Screenshots still-image album or Recents. Listing copy names that path; building album-grid UI is engineering.
  • Distinguish Screen Recordings from Camera Videos — product-page copy should explain why Control Center capture clips live under Screen Recordings while Camera-recorded videos live under Videos when your English listing claims that contrast.
  • Media Types hub (different surface) — format-album grid under Albums → Media Types that lists Screen Recordings alongside Videos, Screenshots, and related rows — not the same hero as a Screen Recordings album grid alone. Mention only as contrast. See Media Types listing (zh-Hans, contrast).
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Screen Recordings support in the binary.

Working Screen Recordings album organization and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. US pages use "Screen Recordings" on the album grid under Photos → Albums. Apple's Simplified Chinese Photos vocabulary often uses 屏幕录制 for the Screen Recordings album hero and Control Center capture marketing, with 屏幕录像 on shorter clip-grid badges.

English listings use "screen recording clips" or "capture videos" on grid frames. zh-Hans copy should describe those items with 屏幕录像 when that matches your English source — distinct from still images in Screenshots and from Camera clips in Videos.

控制中心录屏 & 录制屏幕

Action-oriented screenshots — open Control Center, tap screen recording, see the red status pill — need verb phrases Chinese readers recognize. Frames may pair 控制中心录屏 or 录制屏幕 with the UI your gallery actually shows — Control Center toggle, red pill, or stop-recording control.

Red recording status pill

Many Screen Recordings marketing screenshots show the red in-status-bar pill while capture runs. zh-Hans copy should reference that indicator when your English gallery shows it — without inventing capture claims your listing does not support.

Screen Recordings is a video album for Control Center capture. Screenshots is still screen captures — different buyer promise. Videos is Camera-recorded clips — different source path. If your app supports multiple surfaces, scope each screenshot frame accurately.
